ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the three straight lines AB, CD, EF all intersect at point O. A and B are on two sides of the same straight line AB, so OA and OB are opposite rays; C and D are on two sides of the same straight line CD, so OC and OD are opposite rays; F and E are on two sides of the same straight line EF, so OF and OE are opposite rays. Reasoning: For ∠AOC, its two sides are OA and OC. Replace OA with the opposite ray OB, and replace OC with the opposite ray OD, obtaining its vertical angle ∠BOD. For ∠BOF, its two sides are OB and OF. Replace OB with the opposite ray OA, and replace OF with the opposite ray OE, obtaining its vertical angle ∠AOE.
